change.behavior: Consult the unforgeable accepted-array weak-identity receipt before revalidating mutable caller-owned array shape; return only the existing run Promise. All foreign/initial admission paths and child operations remain unchanged.

test.name: accepted run receipt survives caller array prototype mutation
test.imports: Only node:test, node:assert/strict and the actual core; the core imports the actual custody contract and Node buffer/util/crypto builtins.

baseline.assertion: Pending replay must be reference-equal to the existing run Promise; old code returned a new rejected INVALID_INPUT Promise.

outcomes.timingLimit: Observed local process durations only, not a performance comparison, latency guarantee or throughput measurement.

coveredAssertions: Pending and terminal replay of the exact admitted array after its caller-owned prototype changes to null returns the original run Promise.
The declared native-Promise child is submitted once and closed once; attempted/completed1 and queuedReferences0.
The original native close Promise is preserved and cached.
A different ordinary array remains ALREADY_RUN; a never-accepted null-prototype array remains INVALID_INPUT.
Potential replay rejections are observed immediately; finally resolves/drains the original submit, run, cached close and observed chains on the expected baseline assertion failure.

execution.launcher: Fixed inline CommonJS explicit node:test run API, built-in TAP reporter, no saved helper.
execution.environment: Cleared except fixed PATH/LC_ALL and UID-derived CoreFoundation encoding; host-specific value not published.
execution.limits: Permission grants cover four exact application/package files. Native loader, test-runner, builtin crypto initialization, stdio and OS behavior remain premises; these checks are not hard lifetime/cancellation/native-cleanup or OS/network-sandbox guarantees.

preserved.warning: The prior source-bound tests/results remain associated with their original pins. This new one-case result does not qualify the old full selection against the modified source or qualify default npm test.
preserved.childCloseSelection: Stopped and preserved: a replacement throwing child would not prove failure of the actual cached-native-close-Promise premise.
